items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Videorc's design tokens for GPUI, generated from the same stylesheet as the React theme, every appearance resolved to sRGB; the appearance a window draws, Increase Contrast and Reduce Motion; Liquid Chrome's rasterised fills, beads and token shadows; the overlay motion; and the kit's window frame. Every GPUI item depends on it.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The icons the primitives and the Studio draw: Phosphor's regular, fill and bold weights (MIT) as SVG masks the text colour tints.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Desktop-sized buttons on gpui-base's Button. The default is polished chrome, Record is metallic red that lights while a session runs, Go Live is copper, Chromatic is a ring of flowing chrome, and the rest are flat.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A glass chip whose text stays monochrome: a status chip carries its tone in a glowing dot, an emphasis chip tints the glass. Optional leading icon (Screen hidden EyeSlash, chat arrival marks).

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A glass keycap with a bright top edge and a dark bottom edge, alone or in a group.

items.name: shortcut-keys
items.title: Shortcut Keys
items.description: The one way to show a shortcut: it reads the binding from GPUI's keymap and prints it as the platform's menus do, ⇧⌘J on macOS and Ctrl+Shift+J elsewhere.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A Liquid Chrome switch on gpui-base's Switch: on, a chrome track and the inverse bead; off, a recessed track and a chrome bead.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A Liquid Chrome slider on gpui-base's Slider: a chrome range and a chrome bead inside the track at both ends.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs on gpui-base's Tabs: a recessed glass track whose selected segment is a chrome plate, or a line of words with the selected one underlined.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text input on gpui-base's editor: 28 px, 14 px text, a recessed fill and a 3 px focus ring.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line field on gpui-base's editor: 14 px text, a recessed fill, the chip radius, a 64 px minimum and a 3 px focus ring.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A select on gpui-base's Select: a 28 px trigger with its chevron and a float-glass list that fades in and out.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal on gpui-base's dialog host: the dialog tier of the float glass in four widths, a scrolling body and a footer, fading and growing in.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A popover on gpui-base's Popover: the popup tier of the float glass, 288 px wide, fading and growing in and fading out.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: The tooltip tier of the float glass on GPUI's own tooltip: 12 px words and an optional key chip.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A card that opens when the pointer rests on its trigger and closes when it leaves: the popup tier of the float glass, 288 px wide, fading and growing in over 100 ms.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toasts on gpui-base's toast stack: one neutral float glass for every kind, the kind colouring its icon only, at most three above the status bar.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A pane that scrolls with gpui-base's scrollbar, drawn as the React flavour draws it: no track and a 4 px thumb, shown on hover and while scrolling.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A flush inline status row on the row radius: default, quiet, locked, success, warning and destructive tones, each with its own icon. Only destructive is an assertive alert; every other tone is a polite status.

items.name: section-label
items.title: Section Label
items.description: The small name over a group of rows or fields, 11 px at 600 in the tertiary tier. One recipe for the sidebar's groups, a grouped list's label and a block of fields.

items.name: list-row
items.title: List Row
items.description: The one row for every icon, title and meta list, and the inset grouped list it sits in. 32 px rows split by hairlines, facts unless they say otherwise, with a whole-row button when a row acts.

items.name: navigable-row
items.title: Navigable Row
items.description: A fact row of icon, label and value. When the value's home is another page, the row becomes a button with a chevron that jumps there, and a hint lists the facts a short value stands for.

items.name: panel-section
items.title: Panel Section
items.description: The flush section every pane is built from. A 13 px header as an h2, a 12 px description, an action on the title line, 16 px of padding and a hairline to the next section, with no box around it.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: The one spinner for work in flight, on the icon set's SpinnerIcon: a status named Loading unless it sits beside its own words. It stops turning under Reduce Motion.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A muted placeholder that pulses where content is loading, on the 8 px row radius.

items.name: window-frame
items.title: Window Frame
items.description: The frame the single-pane windows share (Stream Manager, Notes, Captions): the content coat over the window's solid, and the 40 px header band on the traffic lights' line that drags the window, with the title, a quiet inline fact and the window's few controls.

items.name: status-bar
items.title: Status Bar
items.description: The window's 26 px status bar: the state on the left and quiet, clickable shortcut hints on the right, each hint its key in the secondary tier and its word in the tertiary.

items.name: status-bar-action
items.title: Status Bar Action
items.description: One action in a status bar: an icon, a word or both, optionally its shortcut, a pressed state for a toggle, and a tooltip that says its name or more.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status Dot
items.description: Ambient status: the glass status dot in one of five tones, optionally pulsing, and a monochrome label in sentence case.

items.name: pin-window-button
items.title: Pin Window Button
items.description: Keep on top, the pin every detached window shares. One name in every window, a filled pin while the window stays over other apps, a pressed state a screen reader hears, and a header or a status-bar look.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions from a button on the popup tier of the float glass: 28 px items, a destructive variant, shortcuts, checkbox and radio items and submenus. It keeps the wheel from reaching what sits behind it.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu at the pointer on right-click or long press, with Dropdown Menu's popup tier and 28 px items. It keeps the wheel from reaching what sits behind it.

items.name: kebab-menu
items.title: Kebab Menu
items.description: The ⋯ menu for an item's low-frequency actions: one item list grouped by hairlines, the destructive item last, keys on the right, disabled reasons, a busy spinner, and a trigger that can wait for its row's hover.

items.name: kebab-context-menu
items.title: Kebab Context Menu
items.description: The right-click twin of a row's ⋯ menu, built from the same item list so the two menus can never disagree.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: The command palette input, rows and list on the shared dialog surface.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Filter chips on gpui-base's ToggleGroup and Toggle: array values and multiple, pressed items on the chrome plate, named by a Field's label.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Pick one of 2–4 exclusive options on the glass Tabs track: a radio group with roving focus and one tab stop, on gpui-base's RadioGroup and Radio.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: An empty state in words only: short muted text, centred, with an optional 14 px title and an action. No media tile, no illustration and no dashed box.

items.name: page-tabs
items.title: Page Tabs
items.description: A page with tabs. One segmented tab list pinned in a strip under the toolbar, and only the region under it scrolls. Built on Tabs.

items.name: settings-row
items.title: Settings Row
items.description: One settings row: the label and its 12 px description on the left, the control on the right, in a grouped inset list. Twin of React's SettingsRow.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A 16 px checkbox on gpui-base that wears the chrome fill when checked or mixed, with a dash for the mixed state. Disabled reason shows under it.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A 1 px border rule that splits a column or a row.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A disclosure that keeps its trigger visible and shows or hides a panel.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A round face with an optional image and a letter fallback.

items.name: chat-platform
items.title: Chat platform
items.description: Platform names, marks and brand tints for chat rows.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: 14 px / 500 words that name a control. Twin of React's Label.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A named control: label, description, error and the control. Twin of React's Field / FieldGroup.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: One recessed field with addons inside. Twin of React's InputGroup.

items.name: bar-visualizer
items.title: Bar Visualizer
items.description: A row of level bars for mic meters. Twin of Electron's BarVisualizer.

items.name: live-waveform
items.title: Live Waveform
items.description: Centred waveform bars for mic preview. Twin of Electron's LiveWaveform.

items.name: qr-code
items.title: QR Code
items.description: Dark-on-light QR for Phone Pair: ECC Medium, quiet zone of 2, scanners need the contrast in both themes.

items.name: sound-pad
items.title: Sound Pad
items.description: Audiocn-style soundboard pads and grid: modes, playing ring, hotkey chip, progress ring/bar/fill.
